"''No guarantee.|Brasso to Farmer|}} A [[human]] '''farmer''' resided on the agricultural [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]].{{Databank|mina-rau-general-store|Mina-Rau General Store}} In [[4 BBY]], they attended at least one communal gathering between local [[farmer]]s and [[Technician|mechanics]] on Mina-Rau. They ate a meal at the gathering near Brasso, [[Wilmon Paak]], [[Bix Caleen]] and several other farmers. While eating Brasso got up to talk to a newly arrived [[Kellen]]. While leaving Brasso asked the farmer to look after his bowl of food, to which the farmer responded that they make no guarantees; alluding to an early playful conversation the group was having about a second helping of food. ==Behind the scenes== The farmer appeared in the third episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]], "[[Harvest]]", of the [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[April 22]] [[2025]]. Unlike farmers [[Unidentified farmer 1 (Mina-Rau)|one]] and [[Unidentified farmer 2 (Mina-Rau)|two]], who are listed in the episode's credits, farmer 3 is only identified by the episode's subtitles.{{Andor|Harvest}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}} As such this article does not assume which nearby farmer Brasso was talking to. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Harvest}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი ფერმერი 3 (მინა-რაუ) }} [[Category:Farmers]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
